news.title: Senate narrowly votes down resolution calling for end to Iran war
news.description: The vote came weeks before the midterm elections, where President Donald Trump's fellow Republicans are trying to retain their majorities in Congress.

news.title: Pete Hegseth reports at least $3.1 million in cash, investments and Bitcoin
